title: Arkret Common ID and Reference Definitions
description: Shared ID and reference pattern $defs referenced cross-file by multiple object schemas so a single form change propagates without inline drift. Defs-only: not an object or event schema. See zh/models/common-fields.md and artifacts/registry/id-kind-registry.json for the authoritative ID kind registry.

event_id.description: Complete Arkret Event cryptographic identity. The suffix is the canonical unpadded Base64URL encoding of exactly 33 octets: one registered active digest-suite wire_code followed by all 32 octets of the Event digest. Regex validation is only lexical; receivers MUST decode, require 33 octets, canonical re-encode, and verify the suite code and full digest before use.

history_request_id.description: Globally unique history-request object identity; it is never scoped by response stream, requester, service or effective scope.

history_response_id.description: Globally unique history-response object identity; reuse under another request response stream is duplicate_conflict.

account_status_record_id.description: Account Authority issuer-ledger record identity derived from the complete closed unsigned AccountStatusRecord core.

did_core_id.description: Canonical stable DID-derived identity core. The lowercase DID method name follows ak:did_core:, and the remaining method-adapter-defined core is opaque to generic consumers. The did:web v1 adapter uses the complete canonical method-specific-id, never a digest or truncated host. Principal, actor and service identity equality is byte-for-byte equality of the complete did_core_id. A did_core_id is not a DID and cannot be resolved without a full_id or ServiceResolutionRecord.

did_full_id.description: Canonical bare DID used for registration, DID method resolution and owner-published current resolution. It contains no path, query or fragment and MUST project through the registered method adapter to exactly one did_core_id.

webvh_full_id.description: Canonical bare did:webvh identifier used at method-native registration, document and evidence boundaries. Role admission is enforced separately.

human_principal_full_id.description: Canonical bare DID for a v1 human principal anchor. The method set is derived from role_requirements.human_principal_anchor; capability checks for relocation, DID-root recovery and ongoing governance are separate.

managed_agent_full_id.description: Canonical bare did:webvh identity of a durable managed Agent. Its accepted bootstrap history is controller-authored and must contain a continuous inception followed by the create-locked PCR binding update.

did_key_full_id.description: Canonical bare did:key identifier used at method-native key and witness evidence boundaries. This is a registered method-specific DidFullId subtype, not a business ActorId and not a DID URL.

did_url.description: Arkret verification-method DID URL profile (identity/did-usage-and-verification.md section 2.2): lowercase method name, no query, required fragment, fragment limited to ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-]. Every verification_method-family field and every kid/key_ref a schema declares to be a DID URL MUST resolve to exactly this definition; values compare byte-for-byte with no URI normalization or percent-decoding.
